Articles

All vignettes

License review of the criteria

Which criteria TSDFGS includes, which it leaves out, and why.

Choosing a criterion

The training set criteria in TSDFGS, one page each, and what recent comparisons found.

A-optimality

A-optimality minimizes the average variance of the ridge coefficients.

Avg_GRM

The mean genomic relationship between the training set and the target.

Avg_GRM_MinMax

Combines the two: high relationship to the target and low relationship within the training set.

Avg_GRM_self

The mean relationship within the training set; minimizing it spreads the training individuals apart.

CD (ridge, PCs)

CD is the squared correlation between true and predicted genetic value (reliability).

CDmax (ridge, PCs)

CDmax is the largest coefficient of determination among the target individuals.

CDmean

The mean coefficient of determination of the GBLUP contrast between each target individual and the target mean (Rincent et al.

CDmean(v2)

The heuristic form of CDmean from Chen et al.

D-optimality

D-optimality maximizes the information content of the training set, the determinant of the ridge information matrix.

E-optimality

E-optimality limits the worst-estimated direction: the inverse of the smallest eigenvalue of the information matrix.

G-optimality (GOPTPEV)

G-optimality minimizes the largest eigenvalue of the PEV matrix of the target, the variance in the worst direction.

GVaverage

GVaverage is the mean genetic variance of the training individuals, the trace of their relationship matrix divided by nn (TSDFGS returns the trace).

GVoverall

GVoverall measures the total genetic variation covered by the training set: the generalized variance of its relationship matrix.

MSPE of ridge regression

The expected mean squared prediction error of ridge regression for the target individuals (Chen et al.

Partitioning around medoids (PAM)

The k-medoids cost: the training individuals act as medoids of the target.

PEVmean (ridge, PCs)

The prediction error variance (PEV) measures how uncertain the model predictions are for the test set.

PEVmax

PEVmax is the largest prediction error variance among the test individuals, so it protects the worst-predicted one.

r-score

The r-score is the expected Pearson correlation between predicted and observed values of the test set, written in closed form for ridge regression.
